finding.text:
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = ''
set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding + @strDetailKey if @@admin = 0 set @strKey = @strKey + ' and exists(select 1 from kbnguoiduyet y where y.user_id = @@userId and y.status = 1 and y.loai = 1 and a.ma_nt = y.ma_nt )' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id','b.ma_unit', '@@key',@strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId

dir.script:
declare @deststatus int, @uid int, @dduyet date set @deststatus = case @xstatus when 1 then 5 when 5 then 1 else 5 end --else 9 - Huy thi tra ve duyet set @uid = case when @xstatus = 1 then @@userId else 0 end set @dduyet = case when @xstatus = 1 then getdate() else null end
update n14 set status = @deststatus, user_id_duyet = @uid, ngay_duyet = @dduyet where id in (select id from @tblKeys) update h41 set status = @deststatus where id in (select id from @tblKeys)
select '' as message, '$Processed' as toast
declare @deststatus int, @uid int, @dduyet date set @deststatus = case when @xstatus = 1 then 9 else 5 end
update n14 set status = @deststatus, ly_do_huy = @ly_do_huy where id in (select id from @tblKeys) update h41 set status = @deststatus where id in (select id from @tblKeys)
select '' as message, '$Processed' as toast
